summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K updating its 2026 cost and production estimates, including higher iron ore C1 cash cost, all-in costs, and copper costs, while lowering nickel cost guidance. Production volumes were modestly increased for copper and nickel. The filing is a routine operational guidance update, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is involved. The company notes estimates are forward-looking and subject to market conditions. The update triggers a refiling of the Reference Form per CVM Resolution 80/2022. There is no deal to analyze; watch for future operational performance versus revised guidance.
